newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama's consumer prices up 0.1 pct in November.
newsitem.headline: Panama's consumer prices up 0.1 pct in November.

text.p: Panama's consumer price index rose 0.1 percent in November, compared with no change in November 1995 and a 0.5 percent increase in October 1996, the Comptroller General's office said on Monday.

The rise last month brought inflation during the past 12 months to 1.9 percent, compared with 0.5 percent in the year to November 1995. Cumulative inflation for the first 11 months of 1996 stands at 1.5 percent.
Economists say Panama's low inflation primarily reflects the country's adoption of the U.S. dollar as the national currency and a longstanding wage and price control policies.
